senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) leader in council, chief, king.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 3b:29">Ber. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>אדוננו המ׳</he> our lord the king! <cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 8:5">Tosef. Snh. VIII, 5</cite>, a. fr. <he>מ׳ מלכי המלכים</he> the Most Supreme King (the Lord).
<cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 9:8">Ib. IX, 8</cite> <he>אפי׳ מ׳ של מלכים</he> even a king of kings (great sovereign).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 38a:10">Snh. 38ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מ׳ בו״ד</he> (v. <cite ref="B01371"><he>בָּשָׂר</he></cite>) a human chief.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10a:10">Ab. Zar. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מושיבין מ׳ בן מ׳</he> they (the Romans) do not allow the son of a king to succeed his father.
<cite ref="Keritot 5b:79">Kerith. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ ראשון</he> a first king, starter of a dynasty.
<cite ref="Shevuot 6b:8">Shebu. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>מַלְכּוֹ של זה</he> this hyparch’s chief.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:23">Num. R. s. 18</cite> <he>משה מ׳ וכ׳</he> Moses has made himself the chief, and Aaron is high priest &c.; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>מְלָכִים</he>.
<cite ref="Horayot 12a:17">Hor. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>כיצד מושחין את המ׳ וכ׳</he> how are kings anointed? By drawing with the oil the outlines of a crown; <cite ref="Keritot 5b:79">Ker. 5ᵇ</cite>.

Ib. מַלְכֵי בית דוד the kings of the house of David (southern kingdom); מ׳ ישראל the kings of the northern kingdom; a. v. fr.—בַּת מְ׳ Princess, name of a demon afflicting the eye, also a certain disorder of the eye, v. בַּת I.
<cite ref="Shabbat 109a:1">Sabb. 109ᵃ</cite> (Var. <he>בת חורין</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).—Pl. <he>בנות מֶלֶךְ</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 9:27">Tosef. B. Kam. IX, 27</cite> <he>יצאו בנות מ׳</he> the ‘princesses’ (humors of the eye) escaped (in consequence of a blow).
